Lecture 2: Origins of the League

The Ostren League was founded by the merchant Marra Vell.

The League began as a pact between salt traders on the Ostren coast.

The founding is known mostly from later chronicles written by League clerks.

Lecture 2: The founding cities

The four founding cities of the Ostren League were Halvik, Port Ashby, Dunmere and Sarro.

Each city kept its own laws but agreed to shared tolls and a shared defence of the sea lanes.

Halvik served as the League's first meeting place.

Lecture 2: The charter

The original charter is lost. It survives through copies made by clerks.

The League charter required every member city to keep two warships ready.

The charter was written on a single sheet of sealskin vellum.

Lecture 2: The council

The League council met twice a year, at midsummer and midwinter.

Each member city sent three delegates to the League council.

Votes were taken by city, not by delegate.
